title: introduce cost-alchemist profile compiler and adaptive quantizer
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Adds a new profile compiler (Cost Alchemist) that synthesizes tenant-aware batching/caching defaults and emits compact quantization candidates; exposes a readonly /v1/cost-alchemist endpoint and a dry-run CLI; safe fallthrough to existing defaults preserved.
description: Context: customers with mixed workloads needed better defaults for batching, cache affinity, and quantization that respect tenant unit economics. This PR introduces 'Cost Alchemist', a profile compiler that ingests workload sketches, telemetry histograms, and pricing tiers and produces candidate presets for batching window, KV-cache retention, and quantization profiles. Motivation: reduce manual tuning and expensive rollout cycles while avoiding regressions in latency or quality. Summary of changes: 1) new service module redwood/econ/alchemist that implements candidate synthesis and scoring; 2) deterministic dry-run CLI (bin/cost-alchemist) to run on historical traces and export JSON presets; 3) an experimental readonly API route /v1/cost-alchemist/dryrun for internal tooling; 4) telemetry hooks and new unit-econ metrics (alchemist.score, preset.expected_tokens_saved); 5) quant profile generator that emits INT8/FP16 fallback chains and compatibility labels for runtime kernel selection; 6) safety gates: automatic canary selector and a revert plan on perf/quality regressions. Checklist: [x] implementation and unit tests; [x] integration tests against small synthetic traces; [x] perf microbenchmarks (no >2% p99 latency regression in our smoke harness); [x] docs: internal design doc linked; [x] added telemetry dashboards entries; [ ] cross-region rollout plan (follow-up). Related: ENG-2147 for preset format, ENG-2201 for unit-econ metrics. How to review: run bin/cost-alchemist --dry-run --trace samples/tenant_small.json to generate presets; CI provides example artifacts under ci/artifacts/cost-alchemist. Rollout notes: merged behind feature-flag econ.alchemist.enabled=false by default; ops will enable in staged clusters after monitoring 24h. Risk: low-medium; the generated presets are opt-in until we enable autosuggest. Links: design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/board/ENG/2147-cost-alchemist, perf results: ci/artifacts/cost-alchemist/perf-summary.html.
